body: Orchestrator integration note (space-sprint-1 693d5fe): merging DM-269 after DM-268 conflicted in src/core/space/timingActivity.ts (preferHost). Combined rule: host records are read first; an agent record whose identity (or named actor outside an attempt) the host covers is dropped if it cannot be placed (no gap, listed once as duplicate_source — DM-269/DM-176) and otherwise keeps only the time the host reported nothing for, activity or wait (DM-268 decision); keys are metric-free so host waits win; cover memoised (linear). DM-269's src/test/metricsWorld.ts moved to src/test/metricsProject.ts (different helper, same name). One DM-269 test (efficiency.reprojection 'projects again only for dispatches before a host span…') had its setup changed so the host span overlaps the agent span — assertions unchanged — because the old setup relied on the drop-whole-record rule.
